Specialist ground engineering expertise
Explore Gravita’s five connected disciplines for deep excavation, earth retention, basement construction and groundwater management.
/services/secant-piling/
Secant piling for complex ground conditions
Intersecting bored piles form a retaining wall for constrained excavations. Secant piling brings earth retention and groundwater-control considerations into one coordinated design conversation.
/services/diaphragm-walls/
Diaphragm walls for complex ground conditions
Diaphragm walls are reinforced concrete walls formed in excavated panels. They can support deep basement and infrastructure excavations, with the final role defined by project-specific design.
/services/strutting/
Strutting for complex ground conditions

A coordinated strutting system supports retaining walls through successive excavation stages. Its layout must reconcile structural demands with equipment access, excavation logistics and permanent works.
/services/excavation/
Excavation for complex ground conditions
Deep excavation is an orchestrated construction activity. Ground conditions, surrounding assets, retaining systems, fleet movement and material removal must be planned together.
/services/dewatering/
Dewatering for complex ground conditions
Dewatering addresses groundwater within and around an excavation. System selection needs an understanding of the soil, water regime, surrounding assets and approved discharge arrangements.
